description: crate-jmap-types/src/resultref.rs lines 80-101 document the invariant \"T must not deserialize from a JSON object with keys resultOf, name, path\" and back it up with a `compile_fail` doctest proving `Argument<serde_json::Value>` does not compile. This is the right pattern: an invariant that would otherwise live only in the author's head is captured in code AND demonstrated by the type system. A future contributor cannot accidentally widen the sealed set with a struct type without re-reading this. Defend against any suggestion to \"open up\" Sealed for convenience (e.g. \"can we add HashMap<String, String>?\"). The compile_fail test was the right way to lock it in.
title: Argument<T> sealed-trait invariant explicitly documented with compile_fail doctest
